this week the sanctuary lamp burns in loving memory of peggy & peter boyd monday 19th, tuesday 20th& wednesday 21st october pause for hope bringing together in prayer those who have cancer, have had cancer, their loved ones, and those who care for them. sunday 25 october , 3.30 pm clonard church come together for an afternoon of prayer, reflection and support. parish draw 2026/27 the draws for october and november will both take place in november to allow all promoters to finalise their returns. if you’ve not yet done so, there is still time to enter the parish draw. flyers are available in the porches. the draw is an invaluable source of income for parish and with a total of 65 prizes drawn throughout the year the odds are great! st michael’s annual november dead mass wednesday 4th november 7.00pm the annual mass for all our parishioners who have died since last october will be held on wednesday the 4th of november. please see checklist in porches. november dead lists and envelopes are available in the porches. st michael’s parish shop why not call into the parish shop, we have some beautiful candles from the benedictine monks and lots of new products which would make lovely gifts.

manresa jesuit centre of spirituality (426 clontarf road, d03 fp52) - advent 2026 retreat offerings advent triduum retreat mon-fri, 30 nov-4 dec / mon-fri 14-18 dec this guided silent retreat offers an opportunity to step away from the busyness of the season and spend time with the themes of advent - a time of waiting, watching and preparing for the mystery of christ’s coming. advent weekend retreat fri-sun, 4-6 dec themed around the core themes of advent, the weekend includes time for personal prayer and reflection, prayer with others, and the opportunity to meet with a spiritual director. it is a chance to step away from the many demands of the season and make space to notice where god’s spirit may be moving. for more information, check our website: manresa.ie or contact us at
reception@manresa.ie
